summary: Right mid-to-lower lung field, well-aerated and clear on prior, shows new patchy hazy opacity on current.

findings.rationale: Matching by rib levels and hilar position, the right mid-lower lung was dark/aerated with sharp vessels on prior; the same region on current shows new patchy hazy density with blurred margins. Left lung baseline haziness is similar on both exams and was excluded as unchanged. Caveat: differing field of view/collimation between exams.
